summary: First full test run of LC Multi-Dept Resale Marketplace (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 41 pytest cases across health/seed, products (filter/search/sort/pagination/detail/deals), auth (register/login/me/refresh/logout/validation/bcrypt), cart CRUD + auth guards, orders (checkout/empty-cart/isolation) and CORS -> 39 passed, 2 failed (missing brute-force lockout, CORS ACAO='*' with credentials). Frontend: full E2E via Playwright on the public URL -> homepage hero + 6 department cards each showing '50 ITEMS', 8 rock-bottom deals, guest add-to-cart sign-in toast, department navigation (24/page, 2/3 pagination), sort price_asc/price_desc/rating verified against rendered prices, navbar search (3 results for 'Vintage Radio'), product detail + related, register/logout/login (incl. wrong-password error), add to cart from grid and detail page with qty, cart qty +/-, remove, checkout -> 'ORDER LOCKED IN!' with order id + total, cart emptied, orders page lists the order with item thumbnails, guest cart prompt, empty-cart checkout guard, mobile 390px menu with 0px horizontal overflow, 0 broken images, no JS page errors. All core requirements (300 products, exactly 50/dept, low prices $0.99-$19.99, correct images) verified.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection/lockout: 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 with no 423/429 and no attempt counter. Playbook requires lockout after 5 failed attempts.

Responses return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true (CORS_ORIGINS='*' in .env). Browsers reject credentialed cross-origin requests with this combination. Not blocking today because the frontend is served from the same origin, but set explicit origins (FRONTEND_URL) instead of '*' since cookies are used.
Order does not decrement product 'stock' and does not validate availability, so stock is decorative (accepted MVP behaviour, flagging for awareness).
Update removes then appends the item, so a quantity change moves that line to the bottom of the cart list (visible reordering in the UI). Prefer in-place update to preserve order.
Products are seeded only when the collection is completely empty (count == 0). A partial/corrupt catalog (e.g. 120 docs) would never be repaired; consider seeding when count != 300.

issues: Discount badges are unrealistic for a thrift marketplace (e.g. $4.99 vs original $38.51 = -87%) because seed original_price is a random 3.5x-9x multiplier. Tighten the multiplier (e.g. 1.5x-3x) for believable pricing.
Menu has Departments/Orders/Sign Out but no 'My Cart' link; cart is only reachable via the small header icon.

action_items: Add login brute-force protection (lock/429 after 5 failed attempts per email/IP) as required by the auth playbook
Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with the explicit FRONTEND_URL origin since httpOnly cookies with credentials are used
Make PUT /api/cart update quantity in place so cart line order is stable
Optionally lower seed original_price multiplier so discount badges look realistic, and decrement stock on order
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: login has no rate limiting/lockout — only defence-in-depth gap found in auth.
server.py startup seeding is idempotent only for an empty collection; use a count/version check to self-heal a partial catalog.
server.py route order is correct (/products/deals declared before /products/{product_id}); _id is excluded everywhere (verified no '_id' leaks in products, orders, cart, user payloads).
server.py: all Mongo access is async via motor; Pydantic validation present on every write endpoint (422 verified for short password, bad email, qty 0, blank shipping).
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only; data-testid coverage is good (dept-card-*, product-card-*, add-to-cart-*, cart-plus/minus/remove-*, order-*, checkout-*, sort-*).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_*@example.com users via /api/auth/register (with carts/orders) for cart+checkout tests; pytest teardown deletes users matching ^TEST_ plus their carts/orders. One UI-created user (TEST_ui_*) and one admin order remain in the DB.
test_credentials: admin@lcfury.com / admin123 (works, role=admin). /app/memory/test_credentials.md also lists shopper@test.com/test123 which does NOT exist in the DB (must be created via signup) — consider seeding it or updating the file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, runs against public URL, 41 tests, ~11s). Two known-failing tests are intentional gap detectors: TestAuth::test_brute_force_lockout (no lockout implemented) and TestCORS::test_cors_credentials (ACAO '*' + credentials). All catalog, auth, cart, order and E2E purchase flows verified working; focus next run on any new features plus the 4 action items.
rca_of_the_issue: test_brute_force_lockout fails because server.py /auth/login only compares the bcrypt hash and raises 401 — there is no failed-attempt counter or lock field on the user document. test_cors_credentials fails because CORS_ORIGINS is '*' in backend/.env, so allow_origins=['*'] and the edge returns literal '*' alongside Allow-Credentials: true; fix by setting CORS_ORIGINS to the FRONTEND_URL origin.
